run_on_boot.description: Whether to run fstrim once during system boot (before user login).

run_via_cron.description: Whether to enable periodic TRIM via cron (typically weekly on systemd-based systems).

mount_points.description: List of explicit filesystem mount points to trim (e.g., ['/','/home','/var']). If empty, fstrim auto-detects SSD-backed ext4/btrfs/xfs mounts.

items.description: Absolute path to a mount point (e.g., '/home').

extra_mounts.description: Additional mount points (for documentation/comments only). Not used by fstrim binary but useful for operator notes.

items.description: Absolute path to a mount point for reference only.
